extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank used for?
faqs.a: An acid tank stores and transports acid for stimulation jobs. This tank holds 6,000 USG nominal inside an ISO 20-ft container frame for global multimodal shipping, with a carbon steel shell and thick FRP internal lining.

faqs.q: What capacity does the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank have?
faqs.a: The nominal capacity is 6,000 USG in an ISO 20-ft container frame. Capacities are customised to client demand, so state the volume you need on the RFQ.

faqs.q: How is the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank protected against acid?
faqs.a: The carbon steel shell has a thick FRP internal lining and all wetted piping is acid-resistant plastic. A full-FRP shell variant is also available.

faqs.q: What dangerous-goods certification does the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank have?
faqs.a: The listing states dangerous-goods certified, and trailer variants meet the road-authority rules of the country of registration, including dangerous-fluids vessel certification. State the destination country on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Can the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank be trailer mounted?
faqs.a: Yes, trailer-mounted variants are built to the road-authority regulations of the country of registration, covering axles, brakes, lights, gabarit and electrical connections.

faqs.q: What does the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank connect to?
faqs.a: It feeds the acid pump and the batch mixer. See the [stimulation batch mixer](/p/stimulation-batch-mixer-2-100-bbl-frp-lined-steel-ptfe-butterfly-valves-atex), [stimulation pumping units](/c/stimulation-pumping-units) and [transfer pumps](/c/stimulation-transfer-pump).

faqs.q: How does the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank differ from a frac tank?
faqs.a: The acid tank is lined for acid and certified for dangerous goods, while a [frac tank](/p/frac-tank-500-bbl-insulated-trailer-mounted-road-registered) is an insulated tank for fracturing fluid. Do not use an unlined tank for acid.

faqs.q: Where is the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank used?
faqs.a: It is used for acid storage and transport in well stimulation, in an ISO frame for multimodal shipping. See the guide on [frac and stimulation equipment](/blog/frac-and-stimulation-equipment).

faqs.q: What should I send for an acid tank quotation?
faqs.a: Send the acid type and strength, the volume, the lining (FRP-lined steel or full FRP), the registration country and whether the tank is an ISO frame or trailer.

faqs.q: Is a full-FRP version of the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank available?
faqs.a: Yes, a full-FRP shell variant is available in place of the FRP-lined carbon steel shell. State the acid and temperature on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Why is the piping on the acid tank plastic?
faqs.a: All wetted piping is acid-resistant plastic, which resists the corrosion that would destroy steel pipework in contact with acid.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 6,000 USG FRP-lined acid tank as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send your configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
